versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "ultimate-domain-payload" skill, providing a comprehensive meta-domain payload framework for all human activities.
- Features full registry, cross-domain value chains, and twelve life domains standardized under the DPG four-file structure (SKILL, catalog, requirements, exemplars).
- Establishes five fundamental human needs as drivers and six universal operations (S/C/A/O/I/G) for activity decomposition and execution.
- Integrates tightly with Universal Task OS (UTOS); enables cross-domain orchestration and compliance checkpoints when UTOS is present.
- Includes six key cross-domain value chains, explicit O→I mappings, and calibration points to support complex workflows and lifecycle management.
- Provides guide for further domain extension and clarifies relationship with Workflow Refactor, Domain Payload Generator, and UTOS.
